_comment: Wordings the bot may post when an application ticket opens; one is picked at random each time. {user} becomes the applicant's mention. Edits take effect on the next ticket - no restart needed. Every variation must keep the three things we need: Discord username, today's date, and service branch. Delete entries or add your own freely; if this file is missing or empty the bot falls back to TICKET_GREETING_TEXT in commands/.env.
greetings: {user}, thanks for applying! Just to get your application rolling, may I please have you post a photo of your military ID or Veterans Card/DD-214 with a note over it showing your Discord username, today's date, and your service branch like the example below. Cover everything else please and a staff member will assist you shortly! Hope to see you around
